title: BrandingPackage
description: Watermark/branding configuration applied by the Watermark Engine (services/post-processing) during composition: a logo overlay and/or intro/outro clips. Every field is optional - an empty object means no branding.

logo_asset_id.description: Asset id (AssetManager, kind=image) of the logo/watermark image.

logo_scale.description: Logo width as a fraction of the frame width.

intro_asset_id.description: Asset id (kind=video) prepended before the first clip.

outro_asset_id.description: Asset id (kind=video) appended after the last clip.
